title: License a racecourse
what: Hold race meetings only at a licensed racecourse, conducted by a non-proprietary association.

sources.title: Betting and Racing Act 1998 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A race meeting must not be held at a racecourse unless— (a) the racecourse is licensed under this Division, and (b) the race meeting is conducted by a non-proprietary association
